title: Aurum Alpha context propagation and id vocabulary
description: Wire forms for W3C trace context and the portfolio id vocabulary. Governed by standards/040-observability.md; log-line and audit-event schemas $ref these $defs. schemaVersion 1 — evolves additively per PC6.

traceId.description: W3C trace id: 32 lowercase hex, not all zeros (OC2).

spanId.description: W3C span/parent id: 16 lowercase hex, not all zeros (OC2).

traceparent.description: W3C traceparent header, version 00: version-traceid-parentid-flags, lowercase hex, trace and parent ids not all zeros (OC1).

requestId.description: Per-inbound-request id minted at the receiving service's edge; UUIDv7 per contracts/identifiers (OC2). Echoed to the caller as the x-request-id response header.

tenantId.description: The authenticated tenant's public id (OC2). Vocabulary only — establishment belongs to the authorization standard.

contextFields.description: The context block OC4 requires on log lines and audit events emitted within request context. span_id where the service traces; tenant_id where tenant context is established.
